items.title: fix(scripts): PR wrapper leaks materialized trust-anchor dirs in TMPD…
items.summary: fix(scripts): PR wrapper leaks materialized trust-anchor dirs in TMPDIR on failures and interrupts (#180848) * fix(scripts): retire materialized PR anchors on every exit path Materialized wrappers were retired only after fully clean supervised exits, leaking code and dependency links on failures, signals, bootstrap exits, unsupervised commands, and failed execs. Keep creator ownership across the Bash and supervisor exec chain. Share FD/path/PID identity checks, retire drained operations independently of PR lock decisions, and restore cleanup after Bash 3.2 failed execs. Retain code for undrained operations and sweep at most four old owned anchors at startup using creator PIDs in new names. PID reuse conservatively delays sweeping. Legacy names have no liveness record and may be reclaimed after 24 hours even during a long operation. Drained cleanup accepts the same fd-closing escapee residual as clean exits; missing runtime or ownership evidence remains retain-only. Cover lifecycle exits, crash-retained recovery fixtures, dependency pinning, and bounded stale sweeping without changing lock recovery semantics. * docs(scripts): name the stale-anchor sweep residual A dead creator PID is the sweep's only evidence that an operation ended. Descendants that outlive a crashed or undrained supervisor by more than 24 hours can lose their anchor; their PR lock stays retained. Also replace the busy loop in the forwarded-SIGTERM supervisor test with sleep.

items.title: 勒索談判業者疑與駭客組織ShinyHunters勾結，協助經營勒索網站
items.summary: FBI與各國檢警單位追查駭客組織ShinyHunters又有新進展。繼荷蘭與約旦逮捕涉嫌參與該組織的嫌犯後，美國聯邦調查人員近日發現，部分勒索談判業者可能與該組織關係密切，甚至協助施壓受害者支付贖金。

items.title: PHP2Shell漏洞已遭大規模攻擊嘗試，逾2,260萬個實例可能曝險
items.summary: PHP重大漏洞PHP2Shell已出現大規模攻擊嘗試。資安公司Hadrian周三（10/21）在官方報告中指出，已於實際環境觀察到大量針對PHP2Shell的攻擊嘗試。

items.title: Langflow重大遠端程式碼執行漏洞，已觀測逾3,400次攻擊嘗試
items.summary: 資安廠商揭露，低程式碼AI開發平臺Langflow一個風險值9.9的重大漏洞已觀測到超過3,400次漏洞利用嘗試。

items.title: 資安署針對PHP、Node.js、Go緊急更新提出警告，呼籲用戶儘速採取行動
items.summary: 10月21日PHP、Node.js、Go語言開發團隊不約而同發布資安更新，修補一系列資安漏洞，成為IT界與資安界的焦點，這樣的態勢也引起政府機關提出警告，呼籲所有企業

items.title: Fortinet同步修補多款產品漏洞，涵蓋5大產品系列及多個版本分支
items.summary: 網路安全設備廠商Fortinet於10月21日發布多款產品的安全強化更新，涵蓋FortiOS、FortiManager、FortiAnalyzer、FortiMail及FortiAuthenticator等5大系列，影響範圍遍及多個主要版本分支，此次修補包含重大與高風險漏洞，建議用戶優先更新。
